Type: chevron wool runner rug
Use: covering a hallway or bedside floor; hallway, bedroom, living room
Style: modern, contemporary, Scandinavian
Materials: hand-tufted wool, solid and heathered blocks
Colors: ivory, sky blue, forest green, grey, charcoal
Shape: long narrow runner, color-blocked chevron stripes, clean edges, low pile
Feel: fresh, playful, cool
Goes with: white walls, dark wood floors, blue or green accents; modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Chevron Wool Runner Rug, 2' 6" x 8', Blue, Green, Ivory
product.description: New style chevron in blue, green and ivory will enliven your space with color and pattern. This vibrant runner will define a conversation area and add a focal point to your hallway. The soft wool blend is easy to maintain. 2' 6" x 8' Loop construction is easy to maintain. Pair with rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag
